RiinoSite v4 Project

RiinoSite v4 Project

In early 2015, we published riinosite1.0, which was in wixcom, with a fixed template.
In 2017,the website was merged into GithubPage, which is the riinosite hux. Since then, GithubPage is the first option to deploy riinosite.
In 2019, we redesigned entire website from scratch using jekyll, and we dropped the origin jekyll template hux.
In 2020, we merged riinosite with website of low illuminance (li.riino.site), and isolated style template, named it as ‘jekyll-theme-panda’.
In 2022, we get approximately 4 GB data flow each month, and ‘jekyll-theme-panda’ got over 5000 downloads
In 2023, RiinoSite v4 Project is launched, where not only the entire blog website is re-developed using next.js, but also include the power of full stack framework , Notion and LLM. It will support authentication via Auth0 and has modern features like HSTS preload.
 
Some dominant featrues that you are experiencing or will experience:
  • Super fast page loading, due to Server-side static resource rendering from Next.js and resource optimaztion, including lazy loading and dynamic dependcency.
  • Some post are from mdx format, while some post can be from Notion, in a same post list.
  • [WIP] Intergated API services that can be hooked via Auth0, allowing privilege controled pages.
  • [WIP] Database view to support Notion Database and Neo4j Aura.
 
The v3 version is retired.
